category_title: Students with reactive study habits and entity-based beliefs about academic ability
scenario_title: Post-exam reflection and study habit review
minimal_context: During a peer fellow study session, the tutor asks the student to reflect on their recent Biology exam results to determine the causes of their academic difficulty.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's take some time in our peer fellow session today to reflect on the recent Biology exam results and determine the causes of any difficulties you might have had.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I got my grade back and it's really disappointing. I studied the night before the exam and took breaks while studying, but I guess I can't do this. I'm not a Biology person.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What other study habits did you use to prepare for the exam?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I usually study alone primarily. But really, the professor talks too fast. The test didn't cover the lectures in class.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: How do you plan to prepare for the next exam?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: She doesn't teach, care, or want us to pass, so I'm not going to. Everyone agrees with me. I'm just not smart enough.
